alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_setup.text_: Place the emitter above a horizontal belt, leaving one air block between them, just like a Mechanical Press.
A Depot works at the same height. Funnels and hoppers can supply and extract items.
Connect a shaft to either exposed end of the horizontal axle. Use a wrench to rotate the emitter and align the shaft.
alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_power.text_: The default minimum speed is 16 RPM. Individual recipes can require a higher speed.
Recipe durations are measured at 32 RPM. The laser always draws stress from the network while connected.
Higher speed shortens processing, up to the configured effective speed cap. Charging still takes a short fixed time.
alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_belt_proces: With a red lens installed, sand can be transformed into glass. Only matching recipes hold an item.
The item stops under the emitter while it charges and fires. Input items are consumed only when the cycle completes.
The output continues along the belt. Stacks are processed one recipe quantity per cycle; leftovers are retained.
alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_lenses.head: Changing optical lenses
alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_lenses.text: Right-click with a lens to install it or exchange the installed lens. Lenses are reusable.
Nine reusable lenses select different recipes: four colored optics plus Growth, Convergence, Splitting, Power and Eclipse.
Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to remove the lens. Item-handler automation can also insert and extract lenses.
Use multiple emitters with different lenses to build a sequential processing line.
Purple transforms amethyst into quartz. White then transforms quartz into prismarine crystals.
Datapacks and KubeJS can replace these examples with your own production chains.
alchemicallaser.ponder.laser_redstone.te: An unpowered emitter runs automatically whenever its lens, input and speed match a recipe.
A powered redstone signal disables the emitter. An interrupted cycle leaves its input unchanged and releases the belt item.
Removing the signal allows new cycles to start. A Depot can restart processing when power returns.
alchemicallaser.ponder.tag.laser_process: Kinetic processing with interchangeable optical lenses
